title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The ‘Reducing Poverty and Inequality in Malawi’ project in Mchinji, Lilongwe Rural, Balaka, Phalombe and Mulanje districts in Malawi, implemented by Oxfam through ICSP will reach 67,500 people directly from 15,000 households from communities ranked lowest on development indicators. Oxfam will partner with the government and 6 national and local NGOs directly to deliver activities which focus on improving access to GBV essential services, increasing participation of women and girls in decision making, increasing institutional responsiveness in promoting gender equality, resilient livelihoods and enhancing household, community and institutional anticipatory preparedness and capacity.. OUTCOME: IMPACT 2 : People experiencing poverty and most vulnerable to shocks, conflicts and crises are better able to claim and access their rights to well-being, peace and security.
